thread:
ori_csm: LatticeX requests a short-notice lift for a partner demo in So Paulo (BRT). Need: temporary edge allowlist for two partner NATs, route QPS bump to 2200 for the demo route 'latticex-demo', and mTLS client cert pinning. Window: 4h starting 2026-06-02 14:00 BRT. cc @noah_sre @maya_net

noah_sre: Copy. Two quick asks: 1) public egress CIDRs? 2) bursty or sustained? If sustained we'll reserve a small Dedicated slab in sa-east-1.

maya_net: Partner provided IPs: 201.45.67.100/32 and 201.45.67.101/32. Traffic pattern: very bursty (many short generation calls). They also want SNI pinning to demo.latticex.ai and header pin to X-Partner-ID: latticex.

liam_support: Legal cleared demo terms but asked to restrict routing to sa-east-1 and ensure certs are stored with a KMS key in sa-east-1. Also requested a quiet alerts window to avoid noisy paging.

ops_bot: Policy: temporary allowlists max 72h; default expiry 24h unless expires flag set. Example CLI to create allowlist + route override:
```
redwoodctl allowlist create --name latticex-temp --cidrs 201.45.67.100/32,201.45.67.101/32 --expires 2026-06-02T18:00:00Z --regions sa-east-1 --note "LatticeX demo; auto-revoke"
redwoodctl route update --route latticex-demo --qps 2200 --region_pin sa-east-1
```

noah_sre: I'll apply allowlist AL-12017 and canary the mTLS verify change. I'll also reserve a small Dedicated burst slab for the window and set alert suppression for CS-5123 (non-P0 only). Rollback: revoke if error rate >5% or p95 latency >350ms.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy edge-proxy/mTLS-update #5012 -> started (ETA ~5m)

ori_csm: Partner confirmed cert CN=demo.latticex.ai and will upload PEM to the portal in 8 mins. They'll monitor demo and report any anomalies.

ops_bot: Allowlist applied: AL-12017. Rules: 201.45.67.100/32,201.45.67.101/32. Expires 2026-06-02T18:00:00Z. Route override applied: latticex-demo qps=2200 region_pin=sa-east-1. Alert suppression active for CS-5123. Auto-revoke scheduled.

noah_sre: Canary passed (no handshake errors); rolling to prod in 2m. Links attached to CS-5123.

ori_csm: Great work. I'll update account health: pilot progressing, provisioning fast, strong renewal signal. Will follow up after demo for outcome. :rocket:

liam_support: Noted and logged data residency + KMS region in the ticket. Closing loop unless extension requested. :thumbsup:
